notes.text: Typing 12 small tasks took 2s of automation time.
With 12 tasks the Work group in To place starts collapsed, so each Place button is hidden until the group is opened. One extra tap before the first placement.
Tapping Place on a task before its spread is on a day only says 'Add it to a day first.' The order (days, then tasks) is not obvious on first use.
Placing 3 short tasks took 6 taps (about 2 per task).
Hours audit: Work 14h = 6 placed + 8 left, Wedding planning 4h = 0 placed + 4 left, Self 3h = 0 placed + 3 left, Bakery 5h = 3 placed + 2 left
The app never showed an overbooking or over-capacity message.
